concrete_changes.before: Your body is not a temple. It is an electrochemical instrument with approximately seven octaves of signaling bandwidth, most of which you have been trained to ignore. I learned this after tracking my own nasal temperature differential for two weeks. The right nostril ran hot at dawn. The left was nearly cold. The HRV trace confirmed what the thermometer suggested: my autonomic system was biased before I made a single decision.
concrete_changes.after: I began this inquiry with two weeks of nasal temperature readings. The right nostril ran hot at dawn; the left was nearly cold. An HRV trace sat beside those observations. The temptation was to read them as a single diagnostic sentence about my autonomic system. This field guide needs to keep the measurements separate from that interpretation.
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated rhetorical chassis or unsupported identity claim with subject-specific development.

concrete_changes.before: This post specifies three operations. Each bridges an ancient energetic technology with a contemporary biophysical measurement. None require belief. All require execution. The Alchemical framework provides the structural grammar: Nigredo is the deconstruction of the inherited assumption that the body is merely chemical; Albedo is the revelation of the bioelectric field as operational reality; Citrinitas is the solar integration of methodology; Rubedo is the state where the protocols are no longer needed because the instrument has been calibrated.
concrete_changes.after: This post considers three practices alongside contemporary measurements. The comparison is an investigation, not evidence that an ancient energetic description and a biophysical readout identify the same thing. The alchemical stages offer a way to organize the inquiry without becoming its scientific warrant.
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated rhetorical chassis or unsupported identity claim with subject-specific development.

concrete_changes.before: At the cosmic scale, the earth's Schumann resonance — approximately 7.83 Hz, with harmonics — provides a planetary frequency reference that all living systems evolved to track. The heart's coherent state oscillates near this frequency. The alpha band of the human EEG centers on it. You are not separate from the earth's electromagnetic field. You are a node in it. The protocols are not making you more spiritual. They are reconnecting your local oscillator to the planetary reference that has been there since before you had a nervous system to ignore it.
concrete_changes.after: The planetary oscillator image is attractive, but it outruns the measurements described here. The draft’s earlier account linked the Schumann resonance, cardiac coherence and EEG alpha as though one reference frequency explained all three. That linkage needs a separate evidentiary case; it cannot serve as the conclusion of these practice notes.
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated rhetorical chassis or unsupported identity claim with subject-specific development.

concrete_changes.before: This is Rubedo: the Stone is not an object but a state of operational coherence. The perfect balance of solar and lunar energies within the substance. The protocols are not a lifestyle. They are a diagnostic sequence. Run them, read the output, make the correction, and move on. The body is already electrical. You are just learning to read the meter. The system succeeds when you no longer need it — when the Chariot driver has learned to read the sphinxes so well that the reins become unnecessary. The Quine is complete when the instrument plays itself.
concrete_changes.after: The Chariot driver is still a useful companion: two sphinxes, one set of reins, and plenty of room to mistake a readout for an instruction. For this draft, the task is to learn what each instrument can actually report before calling the whole arrangement calibrated.
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated rhetorical chassis or unsupported identity claim with subject-specific development.
